node.title: Re^3: Mojolicious::Lite and Webperl
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
There are now two examples available:

  • [https://github.com/haukex/webperl/tree/993d24d38fd6824bfdcd6f357bb3e122f5d62e9e/experiments/gui_basic|WebPerl Basic GUI Example] - the local web server is [mod://Plack], and it shows how to access a [mod://DBD::SQLite] database on the local machine; the frontend (in the browser) is written in Perl without the help of any JavaScript libraries.
  • [https://github.com/haukex/webperl/tree/993d24d38fd6824bfdcd6f357bb3e122f5d62e9e/experiments/gui_sweet|WebPerl Advanced GUI Example] - the local web server is a [mod://Mojolicious::Lite] app, and the frontend is of course also written in Perl, but this time including [https://getbootstrap.com/|Bootstrap] and [http://jquery.com/|jQuery]. (This example doesn't implement anything fancy on the server side, it just shows how to communicate with the server via JSON.)

I've implemented both so they can be packed by [dist://PAR-Packer] (tested on Linux).
